partially_covered.missing: Organization class only has hasAddress; no explicit properties or classes for other organization details (e.g., contact info, registration numbers, communication channels).
Item and LineItem classes are present but lack properties for item description, classification, or attributes beyond class membership.
Invoice details (dates, reference numbers) are only implicitly modeled through segments (DTM, RFF), but there are no data properties or explicit links to InvoiceMessage.

cq_coverage.details: Coverage is unchanged from the previous iteration. The ontology maintains good structural mapping to EDIFACT, but lacks property-level detail for organization and item information, and invoice meta-data. No new CQs were fully addressed.

issues: No rdfs:label or rdfs:comment annotations on any object properties (:containsMessage, :hasSegment, :hasAddress, :assignedTo, :hasAgentRole, :hasParticipant, :alignsWith, :processes, :validates)
No data properties defined for key attributes (e.g., invoice number, item description, registration number)

strengths: Deep and well-structured class hierarchy reflecting EDIFACT and business roles
Good use of disjointness between major class clusters
weaknesses: No property characteristics (e.g., functional, inverse, cardinality)
No general class axioms or equivalence axioms for complex class definitions
No data property modeling for critical attributes

reasoner_risks: None detected for OWL 2 DL datatypes
Reasoners may produce incomplete inferences due to lack of property characteristics and restrictions

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add explicit data properties to Organization (e.g., hasContactInfo, hasRegistrationNumber, hasCommunicationChannel) and Item (e.g., hasDescription, hasClassification) to fully answer CQ5 and CQ8.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Substantially improved CQ coverage for organization and item details.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Annotate all object properties with rdfs:label and rdfs:comment for documentation and OOPS compliance.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Improved validator compatibility and ontology usability.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Define property characteristics (functional, inverse, cardinality) and add basic restrictions (owl:someValuesFrom, owl:allValuesFrom) for key relations such as hasAddress, hasSegment, containsMessage.
Introduce equivalence axioms and general class axioms (GCAs) for complex class definitions (e.g., InvoiceMessage as Message with header, detail, summary).
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Richer class semantics and improved inferencing.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Expand Address modeling with sub-properties (street, city, postal code) and add temporal data properties (e.g., invoiceDate, dueDate) for InvoiceMessage.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: More granular data modeling and improved CQ10 coverage.

suggestions_ignored: Add explicit properties to Organization and Item for CQ5 and CQ8
Annotate all object properties with rdfs:label and rdfs:comment
Expand Address and InvoiceMessage with granular properties
improvement_tracking.notes: No substantive changes were made since the last review. All major improvement suggestions remain unaddressed, resulting in unchanged quality and coverage scores.

summary: The ontology remains structurally sound and EDIFACT-aligned, but lacks property-level detail, annotations, and advanced OWL features needed for full CQ coverage and validator compatibility. No progress was made on previous high-priority suggestions, so quality and coverage scores are unchanged. Immediate improvements are needed to address missing properties, annotations, and semantic constraints.
